Its coefficients differ from published S4a by as much as 5.6392 log2 units across 16,692 shared IDs. The journal and volcano input agree on their shared fold changes to within 2e-17. The phrase “no pZT12 author effect” needs an RNA-expression qualifier. The lead author reports a pZT12 photoperiod comparison for Rasd1 DNA methylation in her dissertation. It measures a different endpoint and supplies no paired expression effect.
